heading: EXT. MOONLIT CLEARING - THE WHISPERING WOOD - NIGHT

units.text: EXT. MOONLIT CLEARING - THE WHISPERING WOOD - NIGHT
A ring of white birches.
Pale mushrooms glow along the roots.
A stream runs backwards through the grass, climbing a low hill and disappearing into the trees.
The air hums like a plucked string.
Six travellers stand within the ring.
BRIAR THORNWICK (40s, dwarf cartographer, spectacles, a coat of many pockets) unrolls a map and weighs its corners with pebbles.
LYSANDRA (20s, elven archer, silver braid, a quiver slung low) stands on one foot, listening.
FINN OSRIC (teen, farm boy, borrowed sword too large for him) hugs his elbows.
SISTER MERIWEN (50s, wandering priestess, grey robe, knotted staff) kneels and touches the backwards stream.
GRIMBLE (age unknown, gnome tinkerer, goggles pushed up on his forehead) pokes at a mushroom with a spoon.
We are here.
units.name: BRIAR

units.text: He puts a finger on the map.
Lysandra glances over his shoulder.
That is not here. That is a lake.
units.name: LYSANDRA

units.text: The map says lake.
units.name: BRIAR

units.text: The map is old.
units.name: LYSANDRA

units.text: The stream runs uphill. Which is odd, even for this wood.
units.name: SISTER MERIWEN

units.text: Is it magic?
units.name: FINN

units.text: It's something.
units.name: SISTER MERIWEN

units.text: It's glowing. Look! The mushrooms are humming!
units.name: GRIMBLE

units.text: Grimble holds the spoon up.
A fat orange mushroom hums a low C. Finn laughs, nervous.
Between two birches, a pale shape detaches itself from the dark.
A woman in a gown of cobweb and moonlight, hair long as a river, feet not quite touching the ground.
This is the WARDEN OF THE WOOD (ageless, solemn).
She regards them.
You are far from the road.
units.name: WARDEN

units.text: We have a map.
units.name: BRIAR

units.text: Your map is a lie the trees agreed to tell.
units.name: WARDEN

units.text: Briar closes the map.
Lysandra draws an arrow and lets it hang, unnocked.
Finn's sword droops.
Meriwen rises, bowing her head.
We seek passage to the Southern Keep.
units.name: SISTER MERIWEN

units.text: Passage costs a song.
units.name: WARDEN

units.text: I know one! Do you want the one about the frog?
units.name: GRIMBLE

units.text: I want the truest song you know.
units.name: WARDEN

units.text: All of them are quiet.
Finn hesitates, steps forward, and begins to sing, small and out of tune, a farm song his mother taught him.
